content: Jesus Kaokehena Jerusalém Nali

Hatyaoseta Jesus haxaotyakiraharenai kakoa xane kaokehenaha Jerusalém nali. Hoka xane Oliveiras tyairiya nali kaokaha, wenakalatinai Betefagé, Betânia xoaha haliyaseta. Hoka axikatya hinamahare haxaotyakiraharenai

hoka nehena: — Xiyanehena wenakalati xaheta maniya tyaonitere nali. Xiyane ite nali xikaokehena hoka xiyaiyaite boriko mokose exolatyakahare tyaonita, maokatyakaharetata eheno. Hoka maika xamaxolatene hoka xisoa ekakoa ali.
Maika xala xamani axehena xiso: “Xoare maheta nikare xaolihenene?” nehena hoka maika, “Xekohaseti aokitene haomana hoka awisaite isehetene”, xexa ihiyeha.
Hatyaoseta xaneha hoka waiyaha boriko mokose hati kanase jiyakalati haliyita, ekatilikakahare tyaonita. Hatyaoseta aolihenaha hatyo boriko mokose hoka
haiyaharenai axehenahene: — Xoana xamohenene? Xoare maheta boriko mokose xaolihena? nexaha.
Hatyaoseta Jesus iraehenere ihiyeha akereta iraeha hoka hatyo halitinai halakisene hoka xaneha boriko mokose kakoa.
Hatyaoseta nolokaha boriko mokose Jesus ana. Hoka haimanaeha mokaha eheno. Hatyaoseta Jesus tyoka eheno.
Hatyaoseta haiyaharenai kanahotyaha ahoti haimanaeha kakoa, exahe haiyaharenai hoka irikotyaha atya xawali hatyo nalita hoka hatyohare kakoa kanahotyahitaha ahoti aho.
Enaheta xaneterenai, enajikinita tyoiterenai xoaha kawiyahenaha:

content.text: — Wihalahareta hikakoa, Enore! Xekohaseti Enore, waiyira hamohena hexare kakoa tyoitere!
Waiye kaiserehare atyo Davi najikinitare kaokehena womana xekohaseti tyaona maheta Davi akereta! Wihalahareta hikakoa, Enore! nexaha.

content: Hatyaoseta Jesus kaoka Jerusalém nali hoka isoa Iraexatyakalati Hanako hoka tyotya hakakoare wahakoakotya. Xakore hoka koxaka makehena hoka xane wenakalati Betânia nali, 12-hare haxaotyakiraharenai kakoa.
Jesus Irae Halohalo Kate Hiye
Kamaetali Betânia nalita haikoahenahititaha hoka Jesus naka.
Hoka sekota waiya halohalo kate. Kahanahiye kahare hoka xane iri xahita waiyakatetene. Xane hikoa ehaliya hoka ehana taita waiya, maisa iri xowakehetehenere hoka.
Hatyaoseta nexa halohalo kate hiye: — Exe hekotaiya maisa xala hare hirínai hiyohitita — nexa. Nexa hoka hatyo harenai exaotyakiraharenai sema.
Jesus Aihikoakaheta Iraexatyakalati Hanakota

Hatyaoseta Jesus haxaotyakiraharenai kakoa kaokaha Jerusalém hoka isoa Iraexatyakalati Hanako. Hatyaoseta hatyo nali iyakaiterenai exahe betetitere harenai aihikoaheta. Herawatya exoakisa olo ehaikoakihititere harenai mexane, watyaha betetitere harenai nokahakala hoka.
Hoka maisa xala hare xoalini hare kolatya Iraexatyakalati Hanako xeta aokare.
Hoka aotyakisahene exakere: — Iraeti Waiyexe nanekoa atyo exakere Enore niraene kaxairatyaka:

content.text: Nohani atyoite Iraexatyakalati Hana kakaixaretyaka tyotya halitinai anere.

content: Xakore hoka xiso atyo kaiwarexenai xateroakisakala niyahare xamokene! nexa ihiyeha.
Hatyaoseta sacerdotenai xekohaseharenai, xaotyakiyaho kakoa waiyoretereharenai harenai, semaha iniraene hoka aisaha aokowihenaha Jesus. Xakore hoka mairahitene, halitinai awaiyetita exaotyakira hoka.
Hatyaoseta makehena hoka Jesus haxaotyakiraharenai kakoa xanehenahitaha wenakalati Jerusalém nalita.
Halohalo Kate Tahi
Kamaetali weta Jesus haxaotyakiraharenai kakoa jiyehenaha hatyo halohalo kate tyaonitere haliya hoka waiyehenaha atyo, nira atyo ityahare kakoita.
Hatyaoseta Pedro oteheta Jesus niraene hoka nexa ihiye: — Hiyaiyehena, Xaotyakisatiye, etake halohalo kate himaxawaiyerehenerore nira — nexa.
Hoka Jesus nexa: — Exe harira xotya: xityakekoiya Enore hoka
xexaiya exe tyairi hiye: “Hakikisoahena hatyaoseta hoka hiyane onexa hexoahena”, xexaiya hoka maisaiya xamatyakekotita xiraene hoka xityakekoiya xiraene hoka hatyo xiraetere akeretaiya kaomaka.
Hatyo hiyeta nomita xihiye: xiraexahenaira hoka xoalini hare xaxehena hoka xityakekoira, motyaira koxaka kaxekakita ene hatyo harenai xomana. Nikare ite hoka hatyo harenai kaxekaka xomana — nexa.
— Maika xiraexahena hoka ximaotyaneheta hatya iniyalahare tyomehenere hare xikakoa. Nikareya xisaona hoka Xexe enokoa tyaonitereya atyo maotyaneheta iniyalahare xománe.
Hoka maisaiya ximaotyanehitita hatya iniyalahare tyomehenere hare xikakoa hoka maisaiya Xexe enokoa nali tyaonitere maotyanehitita iniyalahare xománe — nexa.
Jesus Xaxaka Ekalorexene Tahi

Hatyaoseta haikoahenahitaha Jerusalém nali. Hoka Jesus tonakoita ene Iraexatyakalati Hanako hoka sacerdotenai xekohaseharenai, xaotyakiyaho kakoa waiyoretereharenai, judeunai nityohalitiranai harenai xane kaokaha ehaliya
hoka axahene: — Xala niraene kakoare hiso hoka nikare hisaonita? Xala xaokala xema nikare hisaonita? nexaha.
Hoka Jesus nexa: — Natyo tehitiyaite naxa xiso. Hoka xekoaxatyaite nomani hoka noxakaite xihiye xala niraene xema exe harenai notyomita hoka — nexa.
— Xiyakaihenaira: xala niraene xema João Batista batixatya halitinai? Xoana Enore niraene xema, halitinai niraene xema kore? nexa.
Nexa ihiyeha hoka hatyokakoaha irae kakoahenaha: —“Enore niraene xema”, wexaiya hoka nexaiya axa wiso: “Hoka xoaneretya hoka maisa xityakekota João?” nexaiya wihiye.
“Halitinai niraene xema”, wexaiya hoka halitinaiya ehareha wihiye — nexaha, mairahitaha halitinai, tyotyaha João Batista iraeti xakaisasehare terota aokahitere hiyeta.
Hatyo hiyeta nexaha: — Maisa wawaiyorexe hatyo akiti kakoa — nexaha. Hatyaoseta Jesus nehena: — Natyo tehitiyaite maisa noxakaita xala niraene xema exeharenai notyomita hoka — nexa ihiyeha.
